name: erp_foodlab
description: Production-ready ERP FoodLab scaffolder with Laravel, React.js, Docker, MySQL, Redis, Pest/Vitest, k6, and Prometheus + Grafana.

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
